summary: Inspect invented building services with layer toggles and explicit geometric clash markers.
objective: Show a floor slab with ducts, pipes and cable trays I can isolate to inspect a crossing.
example_prompts: Show a floor slab with ducts, pipes and cable trays I can isolate to inspect a crossing.
Flag overlapping service envelopes without claiming building compliance.

entities.name: Structure
entities.guidance: Slab, columns and a service zone with authored elevations and penetrations.

entities.name: Services
entities.guidance: Rectangular ducts with elbows, round pipes with joints and open cable trays with side rails.

entities.name: Clash markers
entities.guidance: Place a small bounded marker at the intersecting envelope with both element names.

state_contract.model: Authored element IDs, centerlines, cross sections, layer visibility and geometric envelope intersections.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Adjust a routing control point and recompute intersections.

invariants: Hidden elements remain in clash queries unless the query filter explicitly excludes them.
Reported pair IDs match highlighted geometry.
motion_guidance: Animate layer separation only as a labeled inspection offset.
Recompute geometry and query envelopes together after routing edits.
known_limits: No hydraulic, HVAC, structural or regulatory adequacy claim; envelopes are authored approximations.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Different section shapes identify service families even when color is unavailable.

contact: Intersection detection only, no contact response.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Known intersecting pair highlights both IDs; layer hiding leaves query policy visible.
